title: Community Center
intro: The Community Center is a recreation and event service designed for individuals and families of all ages. We help build community connection by offering fun runs, facility rentals, and year‑round events.

sections.heading: Amenities
sections.markdown:
- Computer Center
- Free WiFi
- Fax
- Chairs
- Scanner
- Projector and Screen
- Small Meeting Room
- Playground
- Event Room with Stage
- 6' & 8' Rectangular Tables
- 6' Round Tables
- Podium
- Full Kitchen
- Ice Machine
- Community Garden
- Covered Pavilion with picnic tables, lights, outlets

sections.heading: Reserve the Community Center
sections.markdown:
Birthdays • Wedding Reception • Conferences • Reunions • Unit Functions • Dances • Engagement Party

- Event Room - 201 maximum occupancy
- Classroom - 15 maximum occupancy
- To secure rental a 50% deposit is required
- Cost is $45 per hour (minimum of two hours)
- Rental time must include setup and cleanup
- Must book 2 weeks in advance
- There will be a $65 charge per hour, or any part of an hour, that goes over the scheduled time
- Facility usage agreement form must be submitted to secure rental
- Balance must be paid in full 10 business days prior to the event
- Any changes made must be made at least 3 days prior to event

*Staff does not help setup, decorate, cleanup for events.*

sections.heading: Dance Program
sections.markdown: Classes available for ages 18 months and up.

sections.heading: Karate Classes
sections.markdown:
Self-defense for ages 7 and up. Classes held on Tuesdays & Thursdays.

**Class Times**
- Beginner: 6 - 6:45PM
- Intermediate & Advanced: 7 - 8:30PM

**Pricing**
- Beginner (Level 1): $40 (1 session/week), $50 (2 sessions/week)
- Intermediate/Advanced (Level 2): $50 (1 session/week), $60 (2 sessions/week)

Receive a $10 discount for each additional family member!

sections.heading: Piano Lessons
sections.markdown:
Ever wanted to learn to play piano? Lessons available for ages 3 and up.

**Pricing**
- (4) 30 minute lessons: $90
- (4) 45 minute lessons: $132.50
- (4) 60 minute lessons: $175

*Additional fees required for music books and materials.*
